question: What is the meaning of share of recycling at end-of-life in relation to material layers, materials?
description: The share of recycling at end-of-life in relation to material layers and materials refers to the ratio between waste materials and reusable and/or recyclable materials generated when a building is refurbished or demolished. This ratio is calculated to determine the circularity of the materials used in the building, focusing on how much of the materials can be recycled or reused at the end of the building's life cycle.
